argv:
import ast,json,traceback
from pyflakes.checker import Checker
codes={'ordinary':'class c:\n    pass\ndef func(c: c) -> None:\n    pass\n','asynchronous':'class c:\n    pass\nasync def func(c: c) -> None:\n    pass\n'}
failed=False
for name,code in codes.items():
 try:
  checker=Checker(ast.parse(code),filename='<public-probe>')
  messages=[type(m).__name__ for m in checker.messages]
  print(json.dumps({'case':name,'messages':messages,'exception':None}))
  failed=failed or bool(messages)
 except Exception as exc:
  failed=True
  print(json.dumps({'case':name,'exception':type(exc).__name__,'detail':str(exc),'trace':traceback.format_exc()}))
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
